title: Align workspace dependency versions
why: Different version requirements for the same registry crate make workspace dependency policy inconsistent and can resolve duplicate major versions.
suggestion: Choose one reviewed requirement in workspace.dependencies and inherit it from production members unless version divergence is intentional.
limitations: Direct production dependencies in internal or private workspace packages are compared textually; Cargo's complete semantic-version intersection is not resolved.
Published package manifests, and renamed, path, Git, build, development, target-specific, or inherited dependencies are excluded.
